name: Aly The Alligator in Space Trouble
summary:
Aly is an alligator with the ability to perform "Dashes" in the air, and loves to wander through the magical green forest.
But one day, he came across a flying saucer and ended up being abducted, taken to an inhospitable planet. Now he needs to find a way to return home.
Upon arriving on the alien planet, Aly finds a space laser gun and a helmet to protect himself from the hostile environment.
Now armed and protected, Aly is ready to face his adventure and the challenges that await him!
Help Aly the alligator overcome the traps and find his way out of the unknown planet before it’s too late.
